Permanent lecturer position (French section 61) at Centrale Méditerranée, with research at Institut Fresnel in signal processing, deep learning and cybersecurity for complex industrial systems. Teaching includes industrial cybersecurity, embedded and cyber-physical system security, dependability and signal processing. Applications by email to rh@centrale-med.fr must arrive by 30 November 2026 at 16:00 Paris time. Provide one PDF with CV, degrees and PhD reports, integration project and identity document. Recruitment is planned for January 2027; no exact start date is specified.

Research: sophie.brasselet@fresnel.fr. Teaching: caroline.fossati@centrale-med.fr. See the attached profile for complete requirements.
